description: Pedestrian and Cyclist Smart Meters 1 November 2020 - 26 September 2021 is a dataset listed in Lake Macquarie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Lake Macquarie City Council. This data was collected by Council's solar powered Q-Free HI-TRAC CMU sensors that use piezo-electric sensors and passive infra red sensors to count pedestrians and bicycles. Note: Only daily totals have been provided. This is not a realtime dataset, data will be updated every 3 months. Coverage: Lake Macquarie, New South Wales. The portal files it under People Counting and Public Space Usage. Its keywords are People Counting, Bicycle Counting. The portal shows 660 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lakemac-com-au-portal.
